Rashi on Kiddushin 27b:10:1.hebrew: ה"ג אלא לאו ע"י גלגול - ולא גרסינן: דקני לה כשהיא ארוסה ואסתתר ונכנסה לחופה כו':
Rashi on Kiddushin 27b:10:1.english: This is the correct reading: Rather, is it not by means of an extension - And we do not read: "That he warned her when she was betrothed, and she secluded herself, and entered the wedding canopy, etc."

Rashi on Kiddushin 27b:10:2.hebrew: גלגול - שקינא לה כשהיא נשואה ונסתרה, ומגלגל עליה שבועה על אירוסין, אע"פ שלא היו ראוין לשבועה בפני עצמן, שהרי לא קינא. ואי קשיא: הויא לה לאוקמא בדקני לה ארוסה ואסתתרה, ומשקה לה משנכנסה לחופה, וקרינא בה "תחת אישך", וכגון שלא בא עליה, דהוה ליה מנוקה מעון — הא בעי לאוקמא הכי במסכת יבמות (דף נח.), ואותיבנא עלה: "מבלעדי אישך" — שקדמה שכיבת בעל לבועל, ולא שקדמה שכיבת בועל לבעל! הילכך, אין לך להשביעה על זנות של אירוסין בשום ענין אלא ע"י גלגול, דזנות אירוסין קדמה שכיבת בועל הוא. וביבמות איכא דמוקי לה כשבא עליה ארוס בבית אביה, ועולא לא סבירא ליה ההוא שינויא:
Rashi on Kiddushin 27b:10:2.english: Extension - That he warned her when she was married and she secluded herself, and he extends upon her an oath regarding [the period of] betrothal, even though [the days of betrothal] were not subject to an oath on their own, since he did not warn [her then]. And if it is difficult [to you: the Gemara] should have established it [as referring to a case] where he warned her while betrothed and she secluded herself, and he makes her drink once she enters the wedding canopy, and we apply to her [the verse] "under your husband," and where, for instance, he had not engaged in intercourse with her, so that he is cleared of iniquity — behold, [the Gemara] already sought to establish it this way in Tractate Yevamot (58a), and we raised an objection against it: "Aside from your husband" — [this teaches] that the intercourse of the husband must precede that of the paramour, and not that the intercourse of the paramour precedes that of the husband! Therefore, you have no way to administer an oath to her regarding infidelity of betrothal under any circumstances except by means of an extension, since [with] infidelity of betrothal, the intercourse of the paramour preceded [that of the husband]. And in Yevamot there is [an opinion] that establishes it [as a case] where the betrothed husband engaged in intercourse with her in her father's house; but Ulla does not accept that resolution.

Rashi on Kiddushin 27b:1:1.hebrew: במה דברים אמורים - דקנה בחזקה דשדה זו את שדה אחרת שאינה סמוכה לה, בזמן שנתן לו כו'. ומטלטלין הנקנין עם קרקע נמי כשדה שאינה סמוכה לה דמי, והיינו דרבא:
Rashi on Kiddushin 27b:1:1.english: In what case is this said - That he acquires, through taking possession of this field, another field that is not adjacent to it [only] when he gave him [the money for all of them], etc. And movable property acquired along with land is also considered like a field that is not adjacent to it, and that is [the ruling of] Rava.

Rashi on Kiddushin 27b:1:2.english: [This] supports Shmuel - That which [the baraita] taught: "Once he took possession of one of them, he acquired all of them."

Rashi on Kiddushin 27b:2:1.english: Its bond is in his hand - All of them are bound by this binding that is in his hand.

Rashi on Kiddushin 27b:3:1.english: There are those who say: Know that he does not acquire - And Shmuel's [ruling] is not [accepted].

Rashi on Kiddushin 27b:3:2.english: And this one shall not be acquired - We do not read [this].

Rashi on Kiddushin 27b:3:3.hebrew: ואמר ליה זו קני מי קני - לשארא? הא אמר ״זו״! הכא נמי, כי אחזקה בהא ואין השאר ניכרות עמה — ״זו קני״ הוא:
Rashi on Kiddushin 27b:3:3.english: And he said to him: "Acquire this one" — does he acquire - [Does he acquire] the rest? Surely he said: "[Only] this one"! Here too, when he took possession of this [field] and the rest are not discernible alongside it, it is [equivalent to]: "Acquire this one."

Rashi on Kiddushin 27b:4:1.hebrew: גופין מוחלקין - וכי אמר ליה "זו קני", הוא משמע, ולא קנה השאר. הכא, לא "זו קני" הוא:
Rashi on Kiddushin 27b:4:1.english: Separate entities - And when he says to him, “Acquire this one,” it implies [only] that [one], and he does not acquire the rest. Here, it is not [a case of] “Acquire this one”:

Rashi on Kiddushin 27b:4:2.english: For the mass of the earth is one - Because all of it is connected.

Rashi on Kiddushin 27b:4:3.hebrew: סדנא - טרינ"ק (טרונ"ק: גזע, גוש, יסוד), כמו סדן של נפחים. כלומר: עשת וחיבור הקרקע חד הוא, דהא כולה מחוברת:
Rashi on Kiddushin 27b:4:3.english: The block - Tronc [Old French for trunk, block, or base], like a blacksmith’s anvil. That is to say: The solid mass and connection of the land is one, for behold, it is all connected.

Rashi on Kiddushin 27b:6:1.hebrew: אמן אמן - יתירא, למידרש ביה גלגול, כדקא מסיים ואזיל: ״אמן שלא סטיתי ארוסה ונשואה״; ולא אפשר לאוקמה אלא בגלגול:
Rashi on Kiddushin 27b:6:1.english: Amen, amen - [This repetition is] superfluous, [written] to expound from it an extended oath [gilgul], as [the mishna] continues and concludes: “Amen that I did not stray [while] betrothed or married”; and it is not possible to apply [the oath to her betrothal] except through an extended oath.

Rashi on Kiddushin 27b:6:2.english: On the curse - “[When the Lord makes] your thigh fall away, etc.” (Numbers 5:21).

Rashi on Kiddushin 27b:6:3.hebrew: השבועה - שהיה משביעה הכהן ואומר: "משביעני עליך שלא נטמאת", כדכתיב (במדבר ה): "והשביע אותה":
Rashi on Kiddushin 27b:6:3.english: The oath - For the priest would adjure her and say: "I adjure you that you were not defiled," as it is written (Numbers 5:19): "And [the priest] shall adjure her."

Rashi on Kiddushin 27b:6:4.hebrew: כנוסה - שייך למיתני גבי יבמה. שומרת יבם — ממתנת ומצפה ליבום, כמו ״שמר את הדבר״ (בראשית לז). להכי שייך לשון כניסה, כדכתיב (דברים כה): ״לא תהיה אשת המת החוצה לאיש זר״ — אלא יבמה יקחנה לאשה בביתו:
Rashi on Kiddushin 27b:6:4.english: Taken in [levirate marriage] - [This term] is appropriate to teach regarding a yevama: A shomeret yavam [is a woman who] waits and anticipates levirate marriage, like [the phrase], “kept the matter in mind” (Genesis 37:11). Therefore, the term of “taking in” is appropriate, as it is written: “The wife of the deceased shall not be [married] outside to a stranger” (Deuteronomy 25:5) — rather, her yavam shall take her as a wife into his house.

Rashi on Kiddushin 27b:7:1.hebrew: אי נימא כו' ומשקה לה כשהיא ארוסה - ומילי מילי קתני, ולא שתשבע על כולם כאחד. וה"ק: בין שהיא ארוסה, בין שהיא נשואה — יכול להשביעה ולהשקותה:
Rashi on Kiddushin 27b:7:1.english: If we say, etc., and he gives her to drink when she is betrothed - And [the Mishnah] is teaching distinct cases, and not that she swears concerning all of them at once. And this is what it is saying: Whether she is betrothed or whether she is married, he can administer the oath to her and make her drink.

Rashi on Kiddushin 27b:7:2.hebrew: לא שותות - אם נסתרו, דבעינן תחת אישה:
Rashi on Kiddushin 27b:7:2.english: They do not drink - If they secluded themselves, for we require [her to be] “under her husband.”

Rashi on Kiddushin 27b:7:3.english: Nor collect a marriage contract - For she caused herself to become forbidden to him.

Rashi on Kiddushin 27b:8:1.english: And he gives her to drink when she is married - On account of the seclusion of betrothal.

Rashi on Kiddushin 27b:9:1.hebrew: ונקה האיש - שלא בא עליה אחר שנסתרה, שנאסרה עליו בסתירה זו:
Rashi on Kiddushin 27b:9:1.english: And the man shall be clear - That he did not have relations with her after she secluded herself, as she was forbidden to him through this seclusion.

Tosafot on Kiddushin 27b:10:1.hebrew: הכי גרסי' אלא לאו ע"י גלגול - ולא גרסי' "דקני לה כשהיא ארוסה ואיסתתרה ונכנסה לחופה וכו'", אלא הכי גרסינן: "אלא לאו על ידי גלגול" — שקינא לה כשהיא נשואה ונסתרה, וגלגל עליה שבועה ע"י אירוסין, אע"פ שלא היו ראוין לשבועה בפני עצמן, שהרי לא קינא לה; וכמו כן מגלגלין שבועה דקרקע, אע"פ שלא שייך בהו שבועה. ואי קשיא: הוה ליה לאוקמיה בדקני לה כשהיא ארוסה ואיסתתר, ומשקי לה כשנכנסה לחופה, דקרינא בה "תחת אישך", וכגון שלא בא עליה דהוה ליה מנוקה מעון? הא בעי לאוקמי הכי במסכת יבמות (דף נח.), ואותיבנא עלה: "מבלעדי אישך" — שקדמה שכיבת בעל לבועל, ולא שקדמה שכיבת בועל לבעל! הילכך אין לך שבועה על זנות של אירוסין בשום ענין אלא ע"י גלגול, דזנות אירוסין קדמה שכיבת בועל הוא. וביבמות (ג"ז שם) איכא דמוקי לה כשבא עליה ארוס בבית אביה, ועולא לא סבירא ליה האי שינויא, דשינויא דחיקא הוא — כן פירש הקונטרס. וקשה: דהא בשמעתין נמי ע"כ סמיך אההיא שינויא, דקאמר: "אילימא דקני לה כשהיא ארוסה ומשקי לה כשהיא ארוסה — 'תחת אישך' אמר רחמנא, פרט לארוסה"; ולמה ליה האי קרא? הוה ליה למימר: "מבלעדי אישך, ולא שקדמה שכיבת בועל לבעל"! אלא ש"מ סמיך אההוא שינויא דבא עליה ארוס בבית אביה. א"כ, הדרא קושיא לדוכתיה! לכן נ"ל דהיינו טעמא דלא רצה לאוקמי בנכנסה לחופה ולא נבעלה: דסבר לה כשמואל, דאמר: "אין חופה לפסולות", וכיון שנבעלה — אין חופה תופסת בה, ולא קרינא בה "תחת אישך". וא"ת: לרב, דאמר: "יש חופה לפסולות", א"כ יכול לאוקמה דקני לה כשהיא ארוסה ונכנסה לחופה ולא נבעלה, א"כ גלגול שבועה מנ"ל? וי"ל: דנפקא ליה מ"אמן מאיש זה אמן מאיש אחר", כלומר שאינה חייבת שבועה על אחר, שהרי לא קינא לה, ומגלגל עליה ע"י אחר. וא"ת: ועולא, אמאי לא מפיק גלגול שבועה מאמן מאיש זה ומאיש אחר? וי"ל: דמהא לא נפקא דמגלגלין על קרקעות; דהא דמגלגלין שבועה מאיש אחר, היינו משום דאותו איש אחר שייך בו שבועה אם קינא, אבל קרקע, דלא שייך בה שבועה כלל, אימא לא מגלגלין. אבל השתא דמדמינן גלגול שבועה דקרקע לגלגול דארוסה — ניחא שפיר, דלגבי ארוסה נמי לא שייך בה שבועה אלא ע"י גלגול דוקא, כדפרישית. וא"ת: לרב, היכי מפיק גלגול שבועה מאיש אחר? הא לא דמי לה, כדפרישית! וי"ל: דסבר "מאיש אחר" דקאמר, היינו אפי' מקטן, שאין מקנאין לה על ידו, דלא שייך בו שבועה; אפי' הכי מגלגלין. ועולא לית ליה האי סברא:
Tosafot on Kiddushin 27b:10:1.english: This is the version we read: Rather, is it not by means of an extension - And we do not read: "where he warned her when she was betrothed, and she secluded herself, and entered the canopy [chuppah], etc." Rather, this is the version we read: "Rather, is it not by means of an extension" — [meaning] that he warned her when she was married, and she secluded herself [while married], and he extended an oath upon her regarding [the period of] betrothal, even though those [matters of betrothal] were not subject to an oath on their own, since he did not warn her [at that time]; and similarly, one extends an oath [to include] land, even though an oath does not apply to it. And if [one should] ask: [The Gemara] should have established [the Mishnah as a case] where he warned her when she was betrothed, and she secluded herself, and he gives her [the water] to drink when she entered the canopy, for [then] we read regarding her: "under your husband," and [specifically] where he did not engage in intercourse with her [yet], so that he is clear of iniquity? Behold, [the Gemara] sought to establish it this way in Tractate Yevamot (58a), and we raised an objection against it from: "aside from your husband" — that the intercourse of the husband must precede [that of] the paramour, and not that the intercourse of the paramour preceded [that of] the husband! Therefore, you have no oath regarding adultery during betrothal in any circumstance except by means of an extension, for adultery during betrothal is [a case where] the intercourse of the paramour preceded [that of the husband]. And in Yevamot (also there), there is one who establishes it where the betrothed husband had relations with her in her father's house; but Ulla does not accept this resolution, as it is a forced resolution — thus Rashi explained. And this is difficult: For in our passage as well, perforce [the Gemara] relies on that resolution, since it says: "If we say that he warned her when she was betrothed and gives her [the water] to drink when she is betrothed — 'under your husband' said the Merciful One, excluding a betrothed woman." But why did it need this verse? It should have said: "aside from your husband, and not where the intercourse of the paramour preceded [that of] the husband"! Rather, deduce from this that it relies on that resolution, that the betrothed husband had relations with her in her father's house. If so, the question returns to its place! Therefore, it seems to me that this is the reason [the Gemara] did not want to establish it where she entered the canopy and did not engage in intercourse: because it holds like Shmuel, who said: "A canopy does not take effect for disqualified women," and since she engaged in intercourse [with the suspected adulterer], the canopy does not take effect for her, and we do not read regarding her: "under your husband." And if you say: According to Rav, who said: "A canopy does take effect for disqualified women," if so, he can establish [the Mishnah as a case] where he warned her when she was betrothed, and she entered the canopy and did not engage in intercourse [with her husband] — if so, from where do we derive the extension of an oath? And one can say: He derives it from: "Amen from this man, amen from another man" — that is to say, that she is not liable to an oath regarding another man, since he did not warn her [regarding him], yet he extends [the oath] upon her by means of the other man. And if you say: And Ulla, why does he not derive the extension of an oath from "amen from this man and from another man"? And one can say: From this it cannot be derived that one extends [an oath] to land; for that which one extends an oath to another man is because regarding that other man, an oath is applicable to him if [the husband] had warned her [regarding him]; but land, to which an oath does not apply at all, I would say that one does not extend [an oath to it]. However, now that we compare the extension of an oath to land to the extension [of an oath] to a betrothed woman, it works out well, for with regard to a betrothed woman as well, an oath does not apply to her except specifically by means of an extension, as I explained. And if you say: According to Rav, how does he derive the extension of an oath [to land] from "another man"? Isn't it dissimilar, as I explained! And one can say: He holds that [when the Mishnah] states "from another man," that means even from a minor, regarding whom one cannot warn her concerning him, such that an oath does not apply to him [at all], and even so one extends [the oath]; and Ulla does not accept this reasoning.

Tosafot on Kiddushin 27b:1:1.hebrew: במה דברים אמורים שנתן לו דמי כולם - ואם תאמר: בלא חזקה נמי קנה מטעם כסף? וי"ל: דמיירי באתרא דלא קנו בכספא. וא"ת: ומאי קאמר "יפה כח חזקה מכח כסף", והלא חזקה אינה מועלת בלא כסף? ואומר הר"ח: דבמתנה מיהא קנה כולם כשהחזיק באחת מהן, בלא כסף. וה"ר שמואל מאיברא פי': "שנתן דמי כולם" — כגון שהמוכר היה חייב ללוקח מעות כבר. והשתא ניחא, דבאותם מעות לא היה קונה; כי היכי דלא מצי לקדושי בהן איתתא, לפי שהוא מלוה — ה"נ לא מצי למיקני בהן קרקע. ובהאי נמי איכא יפה כח דחזקה — שקונה בלא כסף:
Tosafot on Kiddushin 27b:1:1.english: "In what case is this said? When he gave him the money for all of them" - And if you say: Even without chazakah, shouldn't he acquire [them] by virtue of money? And one can say that [the baraita] is dealing with a place where they do not acquire [land] with money [alone]. And if you say: But what is [the meaning of that which] it states, "The power of chazakah is greater than the power of money" — but isn't chazakah ineffective without money? And Rabbeinu Chananel says: In [the case of] a gift at any rate, he acquires all of them when he takes possession of one of them, without money. And Rabbi Shmuel of Évreux explained "that he gave the money for all of them" [as referring to a case] such as where the seller already owed money to the buyer. And now [the matter] works out well, for with that money he would not acquire [the land]: just as one cannot betroth a woman with [loan money], because it is a loan, so too he cannot acquire land with it. And in this [case] too, there is the superior power of chazakah, in that it acquires without money.

Tosafot on Kiddushin 27b:2:1.hebrew: עשר בהמות באפסר אחד - נראה דאיירי שכולן קשורין באפסר אחד, והוא אחז בטלפיים או בשערה של אחת מהן, ועלה קאמר: מי לא קני השאר? וה"ה בשדות, בחזקה של אחת מהם קונה, דלהא דמיא; דאי החזיק באפסר ממש, מאי מייתי מהא? דילמא הכא שאני, שהחזיק בכולן! ונראה דדוקא שנתן דמי כל הבהמות, כי היכי דבעינן בשדות שנתן דמי כולן. ומשני: "התם איגודו בידו" — כלומר, ראוי היה להיות בידו אם ירצה לאחוז באפסר שכולן קשורים באפסר אחד ויקנה כולן, השתא נמי הוי כמחוברות יחד; אבל שדות — אינו יכול לאחוז כולן כאחד:
Tosafot on Kiddushin 27b:2:1.english: "Ten animals with one bridle" - It appears that [the Gemara] is dealing with [a case where] all of them are tied to one bridle, and he took hold of the hooves or the hair of one of them, and concerning this [Rav Aḥa] says: Doesn’t he acquire the rest? And the same would apply to fields: that through an act of acquisition [chazakah] on one of them he acquires [all of them], for it is comparable to this; for if he took hold of the actual bridle, what [proof] is he bringing from this? Perhaps here it is different, because he held all of them! And it appears that [this applies] specifically when he paid the money for all the animals, just as we require with regard to fields that he paid the money for all of them. And [the Gemara] answers: "There, its bond is in his hand" — that is to say, it was capable of being in his hand if he wished to take hold of the bridle, since all of them are tied to one bridle, and [thereby] acquire all of them; now, too, they are considered as if joined together. However, [with regard to] fields, he cannot take hold of all of them at once.

Tosafot on Kiddushin 27b:6:1.hebrew: אמן מאיש זה אמן מאיש אחר כו' - וא"ת: מנ"ל כל הני, הא לא כתיב אלא תרי "אמן"? וי"ל: מחד "אמן" מפיק שפיר אלה ושבועה, ואיש זה ואיש אחר — שהרי אכל מה דכתיב בפרשה קאי; ואלה ושבועה בהדיא כתיב בפרשה, וכתיב נמי "תחת אישך", דמשמע בין מאיש זה בין מאיש אחר. ואידך "אמן" קאי אארוסה ושומרת יבם, דלא כתיבי בפרשה:
Tosafot on Kiddushin 27b:6:1.english: "Amen [if] from this man, amen [if] from another man," etc. - And if you say: From where do we [derive] all these, when only two [occurrences of] "amen" are written? And one can say: From one "amen," one cleanly derives [both] curse and oath, and [both] this man and another man, for behold, it applies to everything written in the passage: and curse and oath are explicitly written in the passage, and it is also written, "under your husband," which implies whether from this man or from another man. And the other "amen" applies to a betrothed woman and a woman awaiting a yavam, which are not written in the passage.

Tosafot on Kiddushin 27b:8:1.hebrew: אלא דקני לה כשהיא ארוסה וקא משקי לה כשהיא נשואה - ותחת אישך דקאמר רחמנא הכי משמע, כלומר: שאת עכשיו תחת אישך. ואם תאמר: מנ"ל לפרושי קרא הכי? הא טומאה תחת אישך משמע, שהסתירה היתה בנישואין! וי"ל, דה"ק: דכי היכי דמרבי מאיש קינוי דאירוסין בריש פרק ארוסה (סוטה דף כד.), הכי נמי נרבה סתירה:
Tosafot on Kiddushin 27b:8:1.english: Rather, [one must say] that he warned her when she was betrothed and makes her drink when she is married - And that which the Merciful One states, "under your husband," means this — that is to say: that you are now under your husband. And if you say: From where do we know to explain the verse like this? Surely "defilement under your husband" implies that the seclusion was during marriage! And one can say that this is what [the Gemara] means: Just as we include a warning during betrothal from [the word] ish in the beginning of the chapter [entitled] Arusah (Sotah 24a), so too we should include [betrothal] seclusion.

Tosafot on Kiddushin 27b:9:1.hebrew: ונקה האיש מעון אמר רחמנא - וא"ת: לוקמה כגון שבא עליה בשוגג, שלא ידע עד לאחר מכאן דנסתרה, דכה"ג מנוקה מעון חשיב ליה — דהא כי מוקי לה ע"י גלגול, לאו מנוקה מעון הוא אם זינתה באירוסין, אלא כיון דשוגג הוא, מנוקה מעון קרינא ביה? וי"ל: דשאני הכא, כיון שבשעת השקאה יודע שבא עליה באיסור, בין שבא עליה בשוגג בין שבא עליה במזיד — לאו מנוקה מעון הוא; אבל ע"י גלגול, שאינו יודע בשעת השקאה, מנוקה מעון קרינא ביה:
Tosafot on Kiddushin 27b:9:1.english: “The Merciful One states: ‘And the man shall be clear from iniquity’” - And if you say: Let [the Gemara] establish [the case as one] where he had relations with her unwittingly, as he did not know until after that [fact] that she had secluded herself, for in such a case he is considered "clear from iniquity" — for behold, when [the Gemara] establishes it by means of an extension [of the oath] (gilgul), he is [likewise] not "clear from iniquity" if she committed adultery during betrothal; rather, since he [acted] unwittingly, we read "clear from iniquity" regarding him? And one can say: It is different here, since at the time of the drinking he knows that he had relations with her in violation of a prohibition; whether he had relations with her unwittingly or whether he had relations with her intentionally, he is not "clear from iniquity." But by means of an extension [of the oath], where he does not know [even] at the time of the drinking, we read "clear from iniquity" regarding him.
